readerCopy.body: The respectable option can be easier, better rewarded, and still require a preference or refusal to remain outside the plan. When Lilith opposes the North Node, conventional approval and a less approved direction face each other directly, making money, cooperation, status, or practical support part of the tension. There is nothing noble about choosing unnecessary difficulty. The important distinction is between useful support and a reward that only remains available as long as an important part of the choice stays unspoken.
